qa_pairs.question: TradeUP Authenticator
qa_pairs.answer:
TradeUP Authenticator is the security App to further protect your security. By enabling 2-step verification, you need to enter the dynamic code generated by your phone along with the transaction password when you place an order, which means the order page can only be accessed when both your password and code are verified.
You can choose whether to enable 2-step verification based on your preferences. To ensure security, we recommend enabling 2-step verification for all users.

qa_pairs.question: Enable 2-Step Verification
qa_pairs.answer:
There are two methods to enable 2-step verification: open the TradeUP app or scan the QR code
1. Open TradeUP to enable 2-step verification.
The first time you open the TradeUP Authenticator, the main screen is as follows:
Tap "Open TradeUP App"
If TradeUP is already installed on your phone, then you will be redirected to the TradeUP 2-Step Verification management page:
Tap "Enable 2-Step Verification" to begin the process
1.1 Enter your login password as prompted
1.2 After the password is verified, tap "Link" to link TradeUP with TradeUP Authenticator
1.3 You will see the successfully linked page. It is recommended you set an alias for easy identification of your account information.
1.4 Remember the dynamic code displayed on your phone (make sure it is within the validity period), tap "Enable w" at the bottom of the page to jump back to TradeUP (If you don't see the prompt, please switch back to TradeUP manually)
1.5 Enter your six-digit dynamic code in TradeUP. 2-step verification has been successfully enabled!
2. By scanning the QR code to enable 2-step verification
2.1 Head to
Account Management
to enable 2-step verification
2.2 Click "Enable 2-step verification" to begin the process
2.3 Enter your login password as prompted
2.4 After the password is verified, you will be prompted to download TradeUP Authenticator. You can click "Next" if the app has already been installed on your phone.
2.5 Open your TradeUP Authenticator and choose "Scan QR code"
2.6 Align your camera with the QR code on the web page
2.7 You will see the successfully linked page. It is recommended you set an alias for easy identification of your account information.
2.8 Remember the dynamic code displayed on your phone (make sure it is within the validity period)
2.9 Enter the six-digit dynamic code on the web page. 2-step verification has been successfully enabled!

qa_pairs.question: Disable 2-Step Verification
qa_pairs.answer:
You can disable the 2-step verification on TradeUP mobile app or the website Please note: Turning off 2-step verification on any platform will disable 2-step verification completely.
1 Disable the 2-step verification on TradeUP mobile app
1.1 Head to
Me>Settings>Account & Security>2-Step Verification
1.2 Tap "Disable 2-Step Verification"
1.3 Enter the dynamic code displayed on your TradeUP Authenticator (make sure it is within the validity period)
1.4 Enter your login password as prompted
1.5 2-step verification has been successfully disabled
2 Disable the 2-step verification on the website
2.1 Head to
Account Management
and click "Disable 2-step verification" to begin the process
2.2 Enter the dynamic code displayed on your TradeUP Authenticator (make sure it is within the validity period)
2.3 Enter your login password as prompted
2.4 2-step verification has been successfully disabled
Please note: After the 2-step verification has been disabled, the associated token will not be deleted automatically. You need to open TradeUP Authenticator to delete the token manually.

qa_pairs.question: Using the Authenticator
qa_pairs.answer:
When you enable 2-step verification, you can use your authenticator for the following situations:
1. To place Trades
2. Deposits and withdrawals
3. Log into your account
On the above pages, you will be asked to verify your dynamic code. Enter the code displayed on your
TradeUP Authenticator
to pass the verification.

qa_pairs.question: TradeUP Authenticator Deleted or Reinstalled
qa_pairs.answer:
Since deleting or reinstalling TradeUP Authenticator will not disable the 2-step verification of the associated account, you will still be asked to enter a dynamic code.
If you encounter this problem, please contact customer service via our in-App  under
Profile > Help Center >  Bubble (bottom right corner)
. Our customer service representatives will help you reset your Authenticator.
